laws.personal_pc: idle services return RAM/VRAM to the user; nothing busywheels when idle
laws.single_token: one shared subagent token authenticates every exposed surface
laws.single_llama_surface: llama-router :8082 is the ONLY network-exposed llama.cpp
laws.app_not_script: long-running services are real apps (exe/python); PowerShell is glue only
laws.meshd_ready: every service = registry row: id, launcher, task, port, auth, health, idle policy

services.auth: none; firewall gates to portal IP 192.168.1.228

idle.policy: forge-mcp supervisor POSTs /free after comfy_idle_s with empty queue; meshd leases cut the timer: committed VRAM + empty queue -> /free NOW (reads C:\forge\etc\mesh_leases.json, read-only)

services.auth: none; firewall gates to portal IP (meshd phase: token check)

services.version_file: C:\forge\llama\version.json (written by update_llama.ps1 / tools\llama_version.ps1; meshd reports it at /healthz as 'llama' for cross-node version sync)
services.updater: C:\forge\llama\update_llama.ps1 (fetch -> build at ref -> stage -> verify -> -Swap with .bak; on demand only)

services.auth: measured: opencode-cli 2.2.7 enforces NO auth; firewall gates to portal IP; OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD = shared token for forward compat

idle.policy: sessions are user-driven; server is idle-cheap (~0.4 GB, no polling)

services.display: mesh node daemon phase 2: status + leases + service control (Rust app)
services.auth: bearer ONE-token (hub-first: meshctl get subagent-key; file fallback); no token = 503, wrong = 401
services.health: GET http://127.0.0.1:8092/healthz (open) + MCP POST /mcp (tools: mesh_status, node_health, node_services, node_caps, mesh_lease, lease_release, mesh_service)

idle.policy: idle-cheap: no timers, no polling; probes run only on request

services.binary: C:\forge\bin\meshd.exe (deployed by C:\forge\kit\tools\deploy_meshd.ps1 from a cargo release build of the repo tree mesh/meshd; dev lane C:\forge\dev\meshd kept byte-identical)
services.version_field: healthz reports daemon version + the node's llama.cpp build (cross-node sync)

idle.policy: none - that is why it was retired (20 GB resident 24/7)
